description: 80-dps SymPy + mpmath derivation and zero-fit empirical audit of QOU's categorical Dirac spatial-Reeb spin-orbit cross-term (`qou-frso`, companion Lean module `QOU/MassTheory/FramingSpinOrbitDiracScale.lean`): (1) proves symbolically that (D.q)^2 * D.dirac^2 normalizes horizontal curvature to 1 and locks the relative spin-orbit coupling to q - 1 (zero independent parameter, c_SO^2 = c_orb * c_Reeb); (2) resolves `qou-frso` Next #2 by showing Nilsson's parameter-free shell-centroid subtraction lifts the 6/7 cap to an exact 7/7 (0 FP) polygon (2.22% of scanned plane, |C| in [0.105, 0.155]), with q - 1 = 0.109979 inside the 7/7 C-projection and exact rational q-window (43/39, 19/17) under the explicit §3b-cond Woods-Saxon ratio D = -C/4 (while bare D = -(q-1)^2 fails 28 vs 40 unconditionally); (3) tests all zero-parameter MeV spin-orbit scale candidates at both q_p and q_mu against 11 experimental spin-orbit doublets and 7 AME2020 two-neutron magic gaps.

caveats: Unconditional vs. conditional boundary (`qou-frso`): (1) The 2l+1 Landé/Casimir shape and the kinetic-normalized Dirac cross-term ratio |C_Dirac| = c_SO / c_orb = q - 1 = 0.109979 are derived parameter-free; (2) Under Nilsson's centroid-subtracted oscillator, |C_Dirac| = q - 1 lands inside the narrow [0.105, 0.155] 7/7-admissible interval (whereas raw c_SO = 0.08926 falls below 0.105 and gives 5/7), BUT achieving 7/7 (0 FP) requires the 3D Woods-Saxon surface-flatness ratio D = -(q - 1)/4 (`RadialSpinOrbitReductionHypothesis`, §3b-cond), since bare algebraic D = -(q - 1)^2 gives 5/7 (40 > 28); (3) In MeV, zero-parameter surface scaling m_p*(1 - q^-1)^2*(2l+1)*A^{-2/3} matches A >= 41 spin-orbit doublets to 10.68% MARE (18.69% across all 11 doublets), leaving radial node (n_r) matrix elements open until the 3D nuclear wave-function reduction is derived.
